name: Morna of the White Neck
text: Morna of the White Neck is the English rendering of the name Muirenn Muncháem, mother of the hero Fionn mac Cumhaill.

attributes.attribute: name of Fionn mac Cumhaill's mother in English texts

sources: MacKillop 2008, s.v. 'Morna of the White Neck'

okr.objective: Documents Morna of the White Neck as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Morna of the White Neck renders Muirenn Muncháem in English.
The name belongs to Fionn mac Cumhaill's mother.
